header.subtitle_sub: The next leap in individual verification, driven by human experience and artificial intelligence.

big_idea.label: [ FRAMEWORK_ORCHESTRATOR ]
big_idea.title: Sovereign Identity Verification
big_idea.body: The Babble Framework provides the Protocols (legal and regulatory hooks) and Tools (forensic perception rails) needed for individual identification across high‑trust sectors – resolving whether a specific human is present, authorised, and operating inside the permitted jurisdictional and policy envelope.
big_idea.subtext: By bridging physical sensor hardware with sovereign digital enclaves, Babble creates an Identity Truth Latch for the real economy.

sectors.insurance_body: Forensic policyholder and claimant identification, non‑repudiable accident and loss‑event reconstruction.
sectors.banking_body: High‑assurance liveness, anti‑spoofing biometrics, and contextual checks for onboarding and high‑risk transactions.
sectors.safety_body: Guardian / minor co‑presence verification and safe‑zone enforcement for age‑gated or supervised services.
sectors.audit_body: Immutable WORM evidence rails for supervisory review, investigations, and court‑grade admissibility.

protocols.eu_body: Designed to interoperate with European trust services and high‑trust electronic identification, while supporting GDPR‑aligned data‑minimisation.
protocols.fatf_body: Supports Customer Due Diligence and ongoing KYC / AML monitoring by providing forensically anchored identity events.
protocols.nist_body: Identity assurance patterns aligned with NIST IAL/AAL guidance and national child‑protection regimes.
protocols.shell_body: Each Babble deployment runs inside a three‑slot governance shell: (1) local law, (2) ISO‑aligned management systems, and (3) jurisdiction‑appropriate financial reporting.
protocols.shell_subtext: The perception logic and forensic envelope are constant; tenants populate the shell with their own local obligations.

rails.vision_body: Identity rail for faces, documents, and scenes. Detects physical light‑bounce and depth geometry to distinguish live humans from deepfakes.
rails.audio_body: Forensic EQ analysis of speech, tone, and room acoustics. Preserves environmental truth and supports conversational KYC.
rails.machine_body: Ingests machine‑native signals (GNSS, RSSI, CAN‑bus) as primary witnesses. Ties vehicles and devices to identity events.
rails.nav_main_body: Babble rejects consumer-grade "Single Point" location data. Every navigation event is established via a four-tier stack to prevent GPS spoofing.
rails.nav_access_body: Orchestrated via WhatsApp, WeChat, and Telegram APIs. The messaging interface triggers real-time sensor ingestion prompts.

triple_anchor.label: ENFORCING_PROTOCOL_INTEGRITY
triple_anchor.space_body: Verifies the physical locus of each identity event or evidence strike against permitted geographies and safe‑zones.
triple_anchor.identity_body: Binds the human, device, or machine role to the observation through sovereign key‑management.
triple_anchor.time_body: Guarantees temporal placement via drift‑corrected sovereign clocks for audit and dispute resolution.

ip.label: Governance Affirmation
ip.quote: The Babble Framework constitutes a sovereign orchestration of governance protocols and forensic tools, ensuring that individual identification, financial transactions, insurance events, and minor‑protection flows can be anchored to globally recognisable standards while remaining tenant‑sovereign.
